newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA STICK WITH TAYLOR FOR ASHES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA STICK WITH TAYLOR FOR ASHES.

text.p: Mark Taylor was retained on Thursday as Australia cricket captain for the forthcoming Ashes test series against England but promoted all-rounder Steve Waugh to vice-captain.
Wicketkeeper Ian Healy, who was suspended for misconduct during Australia's recent tour of South Africa, was axed as Taylor's deputy.
Taylor, whose position as opener was in question after a lengthy form slump, will lead Australia's 17-man squad when they leave next month for the six-test series.
The left-handed opener, who has failed to score a test 50 since the end of 1995, kept his job after leading Australia to a 2-1 series in South Africa.
That success followed the home series victory over West Indies during the southern hemisphere summer.
Selectors also recalled opener Michael Slater after dropping him at the start of the season, while leaving out pace bowler Paul Reiffel.
Batsmen - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh (vice-captain), Matthew Elliott, Michael Slater, Ricky Ponting, Justin Langer.
Bowlers: Glenn McGrath, Jason Gillespie, Andy Bichel, Shane Warne, Michael Kasprowicz, Brendon Julian.
